page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9a.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T25 processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this configuration.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance for compute-intensive workloads where processing power is prioritized over memory capacity. This resource distribution offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that do not require large memory footprints or local NVMe storage, minimizing idle memory overhead. Appropriate workloads include batch processing, web serving, distributed analytics, and compute-heavy microservices.
